name: FTX Collapse and Contagion — November 2022
description: The fastest crypto blow-up in history. On November 2, 2022 a leaked Alameda Research balance sheet reveals it is propped up by FTX's own FTT token. Binance's CZ announces he is selling his FTT on November 6, triggering a run on the exchange. FTX halts withdrawals November 8, Binance signs then walks away from a rescue, and FTX files for bankruptcy November 11. Bitcoin falls from ~$21k to ~$15.5k and Solana — heavily tied to FTX/Alameda — is cut by more than half. Tests crash navigation, contagion-aware position sizing, and shorting a falling market.
